title: Turkish-Style Menemen
description: A classic Turkish dish made with eggs, tomatoes, and spices. Perfect for a quick and flavorful breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: Turkish Menemen Spice Blend (available at most spice stores or online)

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook for another 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the diced potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the Menemen Spice Blend and stir to combine.
Crack in 2 large eggs and scramble them with the vegetables.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or dill if desired.
